commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. The knight-captain tomb opened and his disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. I must find it before the Unbound and the Collector. 2. Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox. 3. Get the key from Ah-Zish by good words or 100 gold, or lift it from him; or take the old adit on the creek bank through water with crocodiles; smugglers are inside, fight or sneak. 4. I do not know what the Root and the Eye really are, nor how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows. I could find out by asking people and reading what I find.
pick Door to Lower Galleries win
use Door to Old Lower Adit

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I found the knights strongbox at Vicrium and took an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It presumably points toward the Root or the Eye. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight to Helstrom; I could study the map first, or keep it from the Unbound and the Collector. I see no other choice. 4. I do not know where the seven towers or the tooth crag are, what the Root and the Eye are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows this. I could ask Nesh-Deeka or read the map.

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka, whose order listens and knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium. She gave the map to her officer to read, promoted me to Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold. 2. Choose the order gift from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom: a rapier or a quarterstaff. 3. Pick the rapier or the quarterstaff. 4. I still do not know how the order listens, who her officer is, what the Root and Eye are, or what the map shows. I could ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passed me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, whom I now report to. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in this same room. 3. Just talk to her; nothing else is offered. 4. I still do not know what the map shows, or what the Root and Eye are. I can ask Never-Writes-Twice.

answer 1. The quest is done. Never-Writes-Twice read the map: the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and she marked it. She warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former member of the order who went mad on sap and killed her minders; I must not listen to her. 2. Nothing further is set; presumably await orders. 3. I could ask more of Never-Writes-Twice or travel toward Skeith Isle. 4. I do not know what the Root and Eye are, where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, or what the seven towers are.

answer I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom; her order listens. At Vicrium, Ah-Zish said he would give the key but it never reached my pack, and the lock could not be picked. I went by the old adit and took the Old Parchment Map from the knights strongbox. Nesh-Deeka named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, paid 200 gold, and I chose the rapier. I now report to Never-Writes-Twice, who read the map: the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. She warned me not to listen to Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap. I carry the rapier and the map, plus about 900 gold, and earlier items like the keystone. Unknown: what the Root and Eye are, what the seven towers are, and how the order knows what it knows. Next: Skeith Isle via Archon or Arorha.
